verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Father of kindness, You have poured out grace
You brought me out of darkness
You have filled me with peace
Giver of mercy, You're my help in time of need
Lord, I can't help but sing

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Faithful You are
Faithful forever You will be
Faithful You are
All Your promises are yes and amen
All Your promises are yes and amen

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Beautiful Savior, You have brought me near
You pulled me from the ashes
You have broken every curse
Blessed Redeemer, You have set this captive free
Lord, I can't help but sing

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I will rest in Your promises
My confidence is Your faithfulness

verse.name: b2
verse.lines:
We say yes to Your promises
Our confidence is Your faithfulness

verse.name: b3
verse.lines:
I will rest in Your promises
My confidence is what You said

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
All Your promises are yes and amen
All Your promises are yes and amen
